errors.text_span: Етикетите са разположени равномерно с интервали от 1 000, като най-ниската стойност е 4 238, а най-високата е 8 169.
errors.evidence: The Y-axis has no labels or numerical tick marks. The description hallucinates that the axis has labels at 1000 intervals and that the lowest and highest values on the axis are 4,238 and 8,169.

errors.text_span: Диапазонът на стойностите е от 4 238 до 8 169.
errors.evidence: This describes the range of the data points for the 'Жилищни' (Residential) line, not the range of the Y-axis itself, which is not explicitly labeled but visually starts near zero.

errors.text_span: Линията за „Административни“ строителства е синя, с плътна линия и без маркери. Тя започва с 4 238 в 2012 г., се увеличава до 5 562 в 2017 г., след което намалява до 3 944 в 2020 г., за да се върне към 8 169 в 2022 г. Видими върхове са 5 562 (2017 г.) и 8 169 (2022 г.), а спадове са от 5 562 до 3 944 (2020 г.).
errors.evidence: The entire description of the trend and values for the 'Административни' (Administrative) blue line is incorrect. The values listed (e.g., starting at 4,238, ending at 8,169) belong to the 'Жилищни' (Residential) grey line and 'Други' (Other) orange line. The actual values for the blue line are much lower, starting at 170 and ending at 70.

The phrase 'се върти до' (it spins/turns to) is awkward and unclear for describing a change in a line graph's value. More appropriate phrasing would be 'променя се до' (changes to) or 'достига' (reaches).
This incorrectly identifies the low point for the 'Други' (Other) orange line. While the value in 2019 is 4,608, the actual lowest point (trough) in that period is 3,944 in 2020.
The 'Жилищни' (Residential) line starts in 2012 with a value of 4,238. The value 4,120 is for the year 2013, which is the lowest point, not the starting point.

The value for the 'Жилищни' (Residential) line in 2019 is 5,980. The line then decreases to 5,860 in 2020. The statement incorrectly assigns the 2020 value to the year 2019 and misrepresents the trend.
The final value for the 'Жилищни' (Residential) line in 2022 is 8,169. The value 4,631 belongs to the 'Други' (Other) line for 2022.

errors.text_span: Видими върхове са 7 047 (2021 г.), а спадове са от 7 047 до 4 631 (2022 г.).
errors.evidence: This is incorrect. For the 'Жилищни' (Residential) line, the ultimate peak is 8,169 in 2022. The line increases from 7,047 in 2021 to 8,169 in 2022; it does not decrease to 4,631.
